record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: If M is an asymptotically flat 3-manifold with nonnegative scalar curvature and Sigma is a stable minimal 2-sphere in M, prove the Penrose inequality area(Sigma) <= 16*pi*(ADM mass)^2, and formulate and prove a corresponding inequality for initial data sets that are not time-symmetric.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a smooth, complete, asymptotically flat Riemannian $3$-manifold with nonnegative scalar curvature, and let $m_{\mathrm{ADM}}(M,g)$ denote its ADM mass. Suppose $\Sigma \subset M$ is a stable minimal $2$-sphere. Prove the Penrose inequality
$$\operatorname{area}(\Sigma) \;\le\; 16\pi\, m_{\mathrm{ADM}}(M,g)^2.$$

Furthermore, formulate and prove an appropriate generalization to initial data sets that are not time-symmetric. Specifically, let $(M,g,k)$ be an asymptotically flat initial data set for the Einstein equations satisfying the dominant energy condition, where $g$ is a Riemannian metric on the $3$-manifold $M$ and $k$ is a symmetric $2$-tensor representing the second fundamental form of $M$ in the ambient spacetime, with ADM energy-momentum $(E,P)$ and ADM mass $m_{\mathrm{ADM}} = \sqrt{E^2 - |P|^2}$. Let $\Sigma \subset M$ be an outermost marginally outer trapped surface (apparent horizon). Show that
$$\operatorname{area}(\Sigma) \;\le\; 16\pi\, m_{\mathrm{ADM}}^2,$$
with equality characterizing initial data in the Schwarzschild spacetime.
artifact.status_search_result: The Riemannian (time-symmetric) Penrose inequality was proved by Huisken–Ilmanen (single horizon, 2001) and by Bray (general, 2001). The full spacetime Penrose inequality for non-time-symmetric initial data sets remains open in general; recent work (e.g., 2025) has established a spacetime Penrose inequality only with a suboptimal constant, and proofs exist under symmetry assumptions such as spherical symmetry. The sharp spacetime version is therefore still an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Present status of the Penrose inequality
status_evidence.snippet: The Riemannian Penrose inequality was proved by Huisken-Ilmanen (single black hole) and Bray (multiple black holes); the general (spacetime) Penrose inequality remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Riemannian case solved; spacetime case open.

status_evidence.title: Proof of the Spacetime Penrose Inequality With Suboptimal Constant
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the spacetime Penrose inequality with a suboptimal constant in the asymptotically flat and asymptotically hyperboloidal regimes.
status_evidence.claim: Only suboptimal-constant versions of the spacetime Penrose inequality are currently known.

status_evidence.title: Stability of the Spacetime Penrose Inequality in Spherical Symmetry
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the spacetime Penrose inequality under spherical symmetry.
status_evidence.claim: Full spacetime Penrose inequality known only under symmetry assumptions.
